tools.name: vintrace_list_work_orders
tools.description: List winery work orders (cellar jobs such as transfers, additions, bottling) with their jobs, assignee, status and scheduled time. Filter by scheduled time range, status and operation type. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/work-orders.

tools.name: vintrace_list_wine_batches
tools.description: List wine batches (the named lots of wine) with volume, variety, vintage and owner. Use include=vessels,allocations to add where each batch sits. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/wine-batches.

tools.name: vintrace_get_vessel_details_report
tools.description: The bulk wine report: every vessel (tank, barrel, bin, press, tanker) with its contents, volume, batch, owner and winery as at a date. Use extra_fields=composition,allocations,liveMetrics to add them. Covers every winery the token's user may access unless wineryId/wineryName narrows it. GET /v7/repo

tools.name: vintrace_get_vessel
tools.description: One vessel by id: a tank, barrel, barrel group, tanker or bin, with its details, dimensions and contents. GET /v7/vessel/<tanks|barrels|barrel-groups|tankers|bins>/{id}.

tools.name: vintrace_list_lab_requests
tools.description: The lab console: analysis tasks (samples to measure) with lab, template, vessel, batch, status and arrival. Completed tasks are left out unless status includes Completed. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/lab/lab-requests.

tools.name: vintrace_list_trial_blends
tools.description: List trial blends (planned blend trials) with status and composition. Use composition_summary_by=variety,vintage to summarise. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/trial-blends.

tools.name: vintrace_search_transactions
tools.description: Winemaking operations completed in a date range (transfers, additions, blends, racking...) with the from/to vessels and before/after volumes. Defaults to today when no dates are given. GET /v6/transaction/search.

tools.name: vintrace_list_barrel_treatments
tools.description: Barrel move shipments / barrel treatments recorded in vintrace, with barrel states and treatment types. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/barrel-treatments.

tools.name: vintrace_list_blocks
tools.description: List vineyard blocks (grower, vineyard, region, variety). To see fruit placements for a vintage pass include=fruitPlacements together with vintage. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/harvest/blocks.

tools.name: vintrace_list_block_assessments
tools.description: List vineyard block assessments (vine and fruit assessments by the viticulture team). Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/harvest/assessments.

tools.name: vintrace_list_bookings
tools.description: List active fruit bookings (grape deliveries planned for a vintage) for one or more wineries: grower, block, variety, expected pick time and quantity. vintage and winery_ids are required. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/bookings.

tools.name: vintrace_list_bulk_intakes
tools.description: List bulk wine/juice intakes (wine bought or received in bulk) with batch, volume, owner and cost. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/bulk-intakes.

tools.name: vintrace_search_fruit_intakes
tools.description: Fruit intake operations (grape deliveries weighed in at the winery): weights, grower, block, vineyard, vintage, docket numbers and metrics. Filter by vintage, grower, vineyard, block or recorded time. Page with first_result and max_results. GET /v6/intake-operations/search.

tools.name: vintrace_list_stock_dispatches
tools.description: List stock dispatch actions (bottled goods and dry goods sent out) with routes, items and shipping information. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/stock/dispatches.

tools.name: vintrace_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments created by Bulk Dispatch and inter-winery dispatch operations, with destination and wine details. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/operation/shipments.

tools.name: vintrace_list_cost_transactions
tools.description: Bulk wine cost movements between two times (cost of wine moved between batches and wineries), optionally for one winery or business unit. Needs the vintrace permission to view costs. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/costs/business-unit-transactions.

tools.name: vintrace_list_brand_allocations
tools.description: List brand allocations of bulk wine (how much of a wine is promised to which brand), by status and vintage. Reply: results plus next_offset. GET /v7/allocations/brand-allocations.

tools.name: vintrace_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order with its lines, state and fulfilment. GET /v7/account/purchase-orders/{id}.

tools.name: vintrace_list_inventory
tools.description: Stock on hand (bottled wine, dry goods, additives) up to a date: quantity, committed, on order and available per item, location, owner, tax class. breakout_costing needs the view-costs permission. GET /v6/inventory.

tools.name: vintrace_lookup_stock_item
tools.description: Find one stock item by code (matched against the start of the code) or by id: type, unit, owner, accounts, tax class and sub-components. Give code or id. GET /v6/stock/lookup.

tools.name: vintrace_get_stock_item
tools.description: One stock item by id with optional detail parts: expand=fields,distributions,notes,historyItems,rawComponents,bulkInfo. GET /v6/mrp/stock/{id}.

tools.name: vintrace_list_stock_item_notes
tools.description: The notes recorded on a stock item. GET /v6/mrp/stock/{id}/notes.

tools.name: vintrace_list_products
tools.description: List wine products as they sit in vessels: batch code, vessel, volume, colour, state and the latest lab metrics (TSO2, pH, Brix...). skip_metrics=true makes it faster. barcode matches a vessel code or asset id. GET /v6/products/list.

tools.name: vintrace_get_product
tools.description: One wine product by id (or by vessel barcode) with its vessel, volume and metrics. GET /v6/products/{id}.

tools.name: vintrace_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with customer, status, price list, line items, totals and invoice date. Filter by status, customer, order date range or invoice date range. GET /v6/sales-order/list.

tools.name: vintrace_get_sales_order
tools.description: One sales order by id, or by order code (for example VSO20): customer, items, prices, taxes and status. Give exactly one. GET /v6/sales-order/{id} or /v6/sales-order?code=.

tools.name: vintrace_list_parties
tools.description: List parties: customers, growers, suppliers and owners, individuals or organisations, with address, phone and email. Filter by the start of the name and category. GET /v6/party/list.

tools.name: vintrace_get_party
tools.description: One party (customer, grower, supplier, owner) by id, or by exact name. Give exactly one. GET /v6/party/{id} or /v6/party?name=.

tools.name: vintrace_get_work_order
tools.description: One work order by id: every job with its steps, summary text, status and assignee. Find the id with vintrace_list_work_orders or vintrace_list_work_orders_v6. GET /v6/workorders/{id}.

tools.name: vintrace_list_work_orders_v6
tools.description: Work orders from the operator's point of view (what is waiting for me / unassigned), with job counts, status and scheduled dates. Defaults to the last 7 days to 3 days ahead. GET /v6/workorders/list.

tools.name: vintrace_search_items
tools.description: Look up names and ids of one kind of item: growers, owners, blocks, varietals, vintages, regions, programs, batches, products, tanks, barrels, bins and more. Use it to find the id or exact name another tool needs. GET /v6/search/list.

tools.name: vintrace_add_stock_item_note
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new note to a vintrace stock item (visible to everyone in the winery, recorded under the token's user). Adding the same note twice creates two notes. POST /v6/mrp/stock/{id}/notes.

tools.name: vintrace_assign_work_order
tools.description: WRITE: assigns a work order to the token's own vintrace user (or to assign_operator_id), so it shows up in that operator's list. With reassign=true it takes over a work order already assigned to someone else. Check the work order first with vintrace_get_work_order. POST /v6/workorders/assign.

tools.name: vintrace_deactivate_booking
tools.description: WRITE: deactivates a fruit booking so it no longer counts as an active booking (the record is kept; it is not deleted). Use vintrace_list_bookings to find the booking id first. POST /v7/operation/bookings/{id}/deactivation.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "vintrace_lookup_stock_item" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "vintrace_get_sales_order" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vintrace_list_parties, vintrace_assign_work_order · Private data: vintrace_get_vessel_details_report, vintrace_add_stock_item_note, vintrace_assign_work_order, vintrace_deactivate_booking · Public sink: vintrace_list_parties, vintrace_add_stock_item_note, vintrace_assign_work_order, vintrace_deactivate_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vintrace_list_parties, vintrace_assign_work_order · Private data: vintrace_get_vessel_details_report, vintrace_add_stock_item_note, vintrace_assign_work_order, vintrace_deactivate_booking · Public sink: vintrace_list_parties, vintrace_add_stock_item_note, vintrace_assign_work_order, vintrace_deactivate_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
